kind: v0.2.0 public preview and owner activation
source_and_package: The tag and remote main both pointed at the clean source commit. The curated wheel reported 24 payload files and that exact source revision. Local make check passed 196 Python and 72 Node tests plus native trial and frozen-eval checks; clean package smoke passed. GitHub Checks run 36532519205 passed on the tagged commit. The release is marked prerelease, not production or frontier equivalent.
public_assets: The release contains the wheel, install-kryn.py and SHA256SUMS. All three were fetched through public HTTPS URLs without GitHub authentication. shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS verified both payload files. The release API digests matched the locally built assets.
private_activation: The identical wheel hash was installed privately with the owner account. --package-check, transactional install, installed 0.2.0 launcher, deep doctor with every pinned model and browser file hashed, local routing, and browser/search connections passed. A guarded native Fast Ask no-tools turn in evals/runs/owner-v020-preview-smoke-20260928/evidence/installed-smoke returned exactly READY in 12.409 seconds. All nine trial acceptance checks passed; sampled pressure was normal and swap growth was zero. Interactive TUI startup reported OpenCode ready and 2/2 tools connected; /report displayed machine-owned evidence and explicit unverified task acceptance.
rollback_and_public_update: kryn rollback restored the prior 0.1.10 owner launcher and source 540cade. The rollback intentionally stopped the owned oMLX server. The old client then reported v0.2.0 available with the exact source revision and wheel hash. kryn update v0.2.0 fetched the published package, verified its payload and transactionally activated the public build. The installed launcher reported 0.2.0; update --check returned current. A fresh public-build TUI launch restarted the owned model, reported OpenCode ready and 2/2 tools connected, and /update displayed no newer release. After clean exit, doctor --deep passed with healthy 96K Qwen3.5-9B-6bit, normal host pressure, zero active/waiting requests, and connected browser/search MCPs. The final installed source is the published wheel, not the private venv.
limits: The native inference smoke does not establish coding/UI acceptance or endurance. Fresh Fast 9B Task12 failed independent browser completion and omitted review, compaction and restart, despite backend tests passing; it falsely claimed completion. Reviewer factual accuracy and native compaction summaries also failed in prior trials. Useful 96K quality, successful sustained active coding and in-session acceptance/restart of a future update remain unqualified. The optional learning worker remains paused and has no proven application-building benefit. No separate-account or protected holdout qualification is claimed.
